tagline.en_US: Runs Windows for ARM as a QEMU virtual machine inside a native LXC on ARM64 hosts, installed automatically from Microsoft images and reachable from the browser or by RDP. Community packaging by Dockur.

description.en_US: Windows ARM runs Windows operating systems on ARM64 systems using hardware-assisted virtualization. It automatically deploys selected Windows editions without requiring manual setup. Users can interact with a complete desktop environment remotely through a web browser interface or standard remote desktop connections.
